name: record-replay-windows
description: Record Windows desktop workflows into semantic event streams and generate reusable Codex skills.

interface.shortDescription: Record Windows workflows and turn them into Codex skills.
interface.longDescription: Record & Replay Windows captures desktop mouse, keyboard, foreground window, UI Automation context, DPI metadata, and key-event screenshots. It exposes event-stream MCP tools and can generate a local Codex skill from a completed recording.
defaultPrompt: Record this Windows workflow and make it reusable.
Stop recording and generate a Codex skill.
Show the latest Record & Replay session status.
